technical-data.invention-title: JOINTS D'ETANCHEITE A FACE SANS CONTACT

abstract.p: The seals have the sliding ring (1, 2, 3, 4, 5) with grooves (r) which at the outer end have a hollow (Zk) according to the lateral plane of sliding rings (1, 2, 3, 4, 5) of 7 mu m, and the surface of the groove bottoms (r) in longitudinal section runs alongside the curve (k) of growth (h) up to approximately 4 mu m. In the transverse section of grooves (r) the surface of bottom runs alongside the curve (k1) of the growth (h1) up to approximately 4 mu m, while in this transverse section both lateral edges are distant to the lateral plane of the sliding rings (1, 2, 3, 4, 5) of the depth (Hp) and (Hk), on of which (Hk) is more distant to the lateral plane of the sliding rings (1, 2, 3, 4, 5) than the other (Hp). And the bigger depth (Hk) is up to 7 mu m.

Cette invention se rapporte à des joints d'étanchéité comprenant un anneau glissant (1, 2, 3, 4, 5) pourvu de rainures (r) qui, au niveau de l'extrémité extérieure, comporte un espace libre (Zk) qui, dans le plan latéral des anneaux glissants (1, 2, 3, 4, 5) est égal à 7 mu m, et la surface des fonds (r) des rainures dans la section longitudinale s'étend le long de la courbe (k) d'accroissement (h) jusqu'à 4 mu m environ. Dans la section transversale des rainures (r), la surface de ces fonds s'étend le long de la courbe (k1) d'accroissement (h1) jusqu'à 4 mu m environ, alors que, dans cette section transversale, les deux bords latéraux se trouvent par rapport au plan latéral des anneaux glissants (1, 2, 3, 4, 5) à une distance correspondant à la profondeur (Hp) et (Hk), l'une de ces profondeurs (Hk) correspondant à une distance supérieure à l'autre (Hp), par rapport au plan latéral des anneaux glissants (1, 2, 3, 4, 5). La profondeur la plus grande (Hk) est inférieure ou égale à 7 mu m.

description.p: The subject of the invention is a mechanical non-contacting face seal.

A common mechanical not-contacting face seal knew so far according to a German patent descriptions nr 3722303 has get a sliding ring which possesses on the face surface spiral grooves of a transverse section diminishing from its start towards the inner end, and at the same time at the very inner end of each groove the surface of the section as well as the depth of the curve equal zero. The bottom of the groove runs alongside the lateral-working surface of a sliding ring.

Non-contacting face seals, according to the invention, possess the sliding rings with grooves which have at the end a recess to the lateral plane of sliding rings amounting to approx. 7 μm, while the surface of the groove bottoms longitudinal section runs alongside the curve of a max. increase of approx. 4 μm, and in transverse section of the grooves the surface of the bottom runs also alongside the curve of the increase of approx. 4 μm however in this transverse section both lateral edges of the bottom, are parted from the lateral plane of sliding rings by the depth, one of which is more dimensionally distant from the lateral plane of sliding rings that the second depth and the bigger depth equals up to 7 μm. Geometry of the grooves of the sliding rings in transverse and longitudinal sections is constructionally connected with the shape: known in the nature of one way spiral grooves, double crossed spiral grooves, X - shaped single crossed spiral grooves, spiral grooves set in the form of the letter A oriented in the direction forward middle part of sliding rings, as well as connected constructionally with grooves which from
the view are the lateral plane of the sliding rings have the shape of surfaces limited by Ω letter shape.

The seals in question enable less labour consuming manufacturing of sliding rings on machines of simple construction than an specialised grinders or laser machine tools, maintaining high accuracy and dimensional repeatability of all grooves in given sliding rings.

The object of the invention in manufactured examples is presented on drawings and Fig.1 shows the face view of a sliding ring with one way spiral grooves, Fig.2 - face view of a ring with double crossed spiral grooves, Fig.3 - face view of a sliding ring with X-shaped single crossed spiral grooves, Fig.4 - face view of sliding ring with A-shaped spiral grooves, Fig.5 - face view of sliding ring with grooves of Ω-letter shape, Fig.6 - longitudinal section A-A through a sliding ring groove 1 from Fig.1 , Fig.7- transverse section B-B through a sliding ring groove 1 from Fig.1 , Fig.8 - longitudinal section C-C through the sliding ring groove 4 from Fig.4 and Fig.9 - transverse section D-D through the sliding ring groove 4 from Fig.4.

Seals according to the invention have sliding rings 1, 2, 3, 4 and 5 with grooves r, which have recess Zk at the end outlet, with reference to the lateral plan e of sliding rings 1, 2, 3, 4 and 5 of 7μm. And in longitudinal section the initial hollow Zp is bigger than the final hollow Zk, and the surface of grooves bottoms r in these longitudinal sections runs alongside the curve _K_ of _h_increase not bigger than 4 μm. In transverse sections of grooves r_ the surface of the groove bottoms runs alongside curves Kl of hi increase not bigger than 4 μm, while in these transverse sections both lateral edges of groove bottoms are distant from lateral surfaces of sliding rings 1,_2,_3, 4 and 5 of the depth of Hβ and Hk which depths Hk are more dimensionally distant from the lateral planes of sliding rings 1, 2, 3, 4 and 5 than the depths Kp, and those bigger depths Hk are within the limit of 7 μm.
Geometry of grooves r_of sliding rings 1, 2, 3, 4 and 5 in transverse and longitudinal sections is constructionally connected with the shape: known in the nature of one way spiral grooves_r shown in Fig.1 , double crossed spiral grooves r shown in Fig.2, X - shaped single crossed spiral grooves r shown in Fig.3, spiral grooves r composed in A-letter shape with hands directed towards the central part of a sliding ring 4, shown in Fig.4, as well as the above mentioned geometry is connected in construction with grooves r, which from the view on a lateral plane of a sliding ring 5 have Ω-letter shaped surface.

The object of the invention, apart from the given examples of construction, can be used in non-contacting mechanical face seals with sliding ring with differently shaped in the outer view of grooves r_.

claim.claim-text: 1. Non-contact mechanical face seals, whose sliding rings have grooves of transverse section diminishing from the start towards the inner end whose characteristic feature is that the sliding rings (Y), (2), (3), (4), (5) with grooves (r) having a recess (ZkJ according to the lateral plane of sliding ring (1), (2), (3), (4) , (5) of approximately 7 μm at the end, and the surface of the groove bottom (r) in longitudinal section runs alongside the curve (k) of a maximum increase (h) up to approximately 4 μm, while in the transverse section of grooves the surface of the bottom runs alongside the curve kl of the growth up to approximately 4 μm, moreover in this transverse section both lateral planes of the bottom are distant to the lateral plane of sliding rings (1), (2), (3), (4), (5) of the depth of (Hp.) and (Hk), one of which (Hk) is more distant from the lateral plane of sliding rings rings (V), (2), (3), (4), (5) than the second depth (HpJ, and the bigger depth (Hk) is up to 7 μm.

2. Non-contacting mechanical face seals, according to Claim 1 , are characterised by the fact that the geometry of the grooves (r) of sliding rings (1) in transverse and longitudinal sections is constructionally connected with the shape of known in nature one way spiral grooves (r).

3. Non-contacting mechanical face seals, according to Claim 1 , are characterised by the fact that the geometry of the grooves (r) of sliding rings (2) is constructionally connected with double crossed spiral grooves (r).

4. Non-contacting mechanical face seals, according to Claim 1 , are characterised by the fact that the geometry of sliding rings (3) is constructionally connected with X - shaped single crossed spiral grooves (r).

5. Non-contacting mechanical face seals, according to Claim 1 , are characterised by the fact that the geometry of grooves (r) of sliding rings (4) is constructionally connected with spiral grooves (r) set in lateral plane of the sliding rings (4) in the shape of A-letter with hands directed towards the central part of sliding rings (4).

6. Non-contacting mechanical face seals, according to Claim 1 , is characterised by the fact that the geometry of the grooves (r) of sliding rings (5) is constructionally connected with the grooves (r) , which from the view on the lateral plane of sliding rings (5) have the shape of the letter (Ω).
